$comment: The documentation pages of the site, in sidebar order. scripts/build-site.mjs renders each Markdown file (the single source; it stays in the repository) to site-dist/docs/<slug>.html with scripts/docs-render.mjs, and docs/index.html from the groups and descriptions below. title is the sidebar name (the page itself keeps the file's first heading); description is the line on the overview page and the page's meta description. hideImages: images the Markdown shows on GitHub that the site leaves out, each with its reason (the build fails on an entry that no longer leaves anything out). Turkish sources live in docs/tr/<source basename>.md and render under /docs/tr/. titleTr names groups and pages in Turkish. Relative Markdown links resolve against the English source location; translated headings retain the corresponding English heading IDs. Missing translations show the English body with a Turkish notice.
